correctness.rationale: All \(2^{10}\) five-vertex graph masks and all \(2^{15}\) six-vertex graph masks are exhausted with independent chordality predicates. The 34 actual \(S_5\) orbits partition 1024 frequencies and direct signed sums have exactly representatives 28, 31, 185 as zero. At order six, the count 18154 and fixed-edge incidence count 8524 are independently reproduced; the product identity yields \(W_6(S)\equiv2\pmod4\) for every S. Signed sum at mask 639 equals 2. An independent exact butterfly program reproduces full zero counts and Parseval 841728 and 594870272. The proof explicitly states normalizations, finite quantifiers, algorithmic exhaustion and limits.

value.rationale: The exact first singular five-vertex chordal-graph convolution and immediately invertible six-vertex case answer a natural identifiable edge-parity observable question for a foundational graph class. The three-motif zero classification is not merely an aggregate count and is necessary to describe the entire missing observation subspace. The n6 congruence yields full recovery and a sharp inverse norm from only two graph incidence counts. This is a complete motivated finite cutoff/contrast; higher orders are explicitly outside the scope.
